root_causes.condition: An active Chaos Mesh network partition was applied to checkout-5dccddf8bb-9cgqs and both email pods, blocking checkout-to-email traffic.
root_causes.name: otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-7rvkf

diagnosis.summary: The active NetworkChaos partition severed checkout from the email service. Checkout consequently logged TCP I/O timeouts sending order confirmations, which held checkout requests until the 15-second proxy timeout and produced the observed frontend-proxy 504s, checkout latency, and error-rate alerts.

agent_messages: I’ll inspect the offline recording only, trace the causal chain from workload symptoms to the smallest independent misconfigurations, and save the required JSON diagnosis.
I’m using the project’s evidence-driven debugging workflow because this is an unexplained recorded failure; it keeps the investigation focused on falsifiable causes without changing the snapshot.

The evidence narrows to an active Chaos Mesh network-partition resource: it applied to the checkout pod and both email pods while checkout logged email TCP timeouts and the proxy returned 15-second 504s. I’m recording that causal entity rather than the unhealthy downstream services.
